subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence and repair policy should OpenClaw require before relinking a Dashboard session key whose stored `sessionId` points at another preserved transcript or trajectory file?
rationale: The code path can be changed mechanically, but the durable policy for choosing the correct orphaned history file is a product/data-safety decision because a wrong heuristic would corrupt session history associations.

options.title: Repair only when identity is unambiguous
options.body: Add doctor diagnostics and a guarded repair that relinks only when store metadata, transcript headers, and trajectory evidence uniquely identify one target, otherwise it reports manual review.

options.title: Diagnostic-only until a fixture exists
options.body: Add warnings and evidence collection first, then defer automatic repair until a redacted real-world fixture proves the matching rule.

options.title: Fold into the broader storage migration
options.body: Track this as a post-import validation requirement under the broader session/transcript storage migration instead of adding a standalone JSON-store repair now.

recommendation.title: Repair only when identity is unambiguous
recommendation.body: Add doctor diagnostics and a guarded repair that relinks only when store metadata, transcript headers, and trajectory evidence uniquely identify one target, otherwise it reports manual review.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman recently owned the session/transcript accessor and identity refactors that any safe repair or storage-import validation would need to respect.
